evals.prompt:
I need a complete branded skin for our Brightcove player. Here's the embed:

```html
<video-js 
   data-video-id="4825279519001" 
   data-account="1752604059001" 
   data-player="default" 
   data-embed="default" 
   class="video-js" 
   controls>
</video-js>
<script src="https://players.brightcove.net/1752604059001/default_default/index.min.js"></script>
```

Brand requirements:
- **Big play button**: gradient background (top-to-bottom, two stops), a colored solid border (0.1rem), matching text/icon color, ~70% opacity
- **Control bar**: distinct background color, custom icon color inherited by all controls
- **Play toggle**: its own accent color (different from control bar)
- **Volume button**: its own color
- **Volume bar track**: colored; filled portion (volume level) a different color
- **Current time**: teal
- **Time divider**: bold, slightly smaller than default (0.9em), own color
- **Duration**: italic, same color as current time
- **Seek bar** (progress control): colored, 1em tall
- **Play progress bar**: different color from seek bar, also 1em tall
- **Chapters button**: its own color
- **Captions button**: white text, dark background
- **Fullscreen toggle**: bold, colored
- **Dock text overlay**: two-layer gradient treatment—a base gradient on `.vjs-dock-text` (no class scope), then a semi-transparent gradient override scoped to `.video-js .vjs-dock-text` with opacity
- **Dock title**: sans-serif, 1em
- **Dock description**: white, 0.8em

Give me a complete, self-contained HTML demo file I can open in a browser.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML file that embeds the Brightcove player and applies custom CSS (inside an @layer block with !important declarations) targeting all listed components: .vjs-big-play-button, .vjs-control-bar, .vjs-play-control, a volume button selector (.vjs-mute-control/.vjs-volume-menu-button/.vjs-volume-panel), .vjs-volume-bar, .vjs-volume-level, current-time and duration selectors, .vjs-time-divider, a seek bar track selector (.vjs-progress-holder or similar), .vjs-play-progress, .vjs-chapters-button, .vjs-captions-button, .vjs-fullscreen-control, .vjs-dock-text (both scoped and unscoped), .vjs-dock-title, .vjs-dock-description. Should use a wrapper container and proper specificity techniques.
expectations: Output is an HTML file containing a complete page structure (doctype, html, head, body)
The player embed uses data-account="1752604059001" and the correct script URL
CSS is placed inside an @layer block (unnamed or named) for specificity
!important is used on at least several CSS property values
The .vjs-big-play-button selector is present with a gradient background, border, and opacity
The .vjs-control-bar selector is present with a background-color
The .vjs-play-control selector is present with a color
A volume button selector is present: .vjs-mute-control, .vjs-volume-menu-button, or .vjs-volume-panel
The .vjs-volume-bar selector is present
The .vjs-volume-level selector is present
Selectors for current time and duration are present with color values (.vjs-current-time or .vjs-current-time-display; .vjs-duration or .vjs-duration-display)
The .vjs-time-divider selector is present with font-weight and font-size
A duration selector (.vjs-duration or .vjs-duration-display) has font-style italic or text-decoration italic
The seek bar track has height 1em (.vjs-progress-holder, .vjs-progress-control, or a descendant slider selector)
The .vjs-play-progress selector is present with a height of 1em
The .vjs-chapters-button selector is present
The .vjs-captions-button selector is present
The .vjs-fullscreen-control selector is present with font-weight bold
The .vjs-dock-text selector is present in two forms: unscoped (.vjs-dock-text) and scoped (.video-js .vjs-dock-text)
The .vjs-dock-title selector has font-family set to sans-serif
The .vjs-dock-description selector has font-size and a color
